w10_T4_003255: Priya hosts a daily podcast and keeps her recording log in minutes. Each weekday she records 82 minutes of interviews, then adds 39 minutes of commentary and 33 minutes of listener calls. She records exactly this much on each of 5 weekdays. During editing that week she cuts a total of 217 minutes from the combined footage. She never converts her log to hours, even though sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes of footage remain after editing?
w10_T4_003258: Marco and Lena are playing an arcade game and comparing scores. Marco starts the second level with 131 points, while Lena has only 98 points at that moment. Marco collects a bonus worth 65 points, then loses 110 points when his character falls into a pit. A power-up then applies a multiplier of 9 to his score. He is hit by a trap that costs him 558 points, and finally the end-of-level bonus applies a multiplier of 4 to his score. Lena's high score from last week was 3000 points. How many points does Marco have at the end of the level?
w10_T4_003263: In the morning Hana collected 115 eggs from her hens, while her neighbour Tomas collected only 88 from his. On the way to the market, 46 of Hana's eggs cracked and had to be thrown away. In the afternoon she sold every remaining egg for 4 dollars each. Tomas also paid her 16 dollars that he owed her. In the evening she spent 255 dollars on chicken feed. How many dollars did Hana have left?
w10_T4_003265: Nadia has 86 sheets of stickers, while her brother Omar has 60 sheets, so she has more than him. Nadia has been collecting stickers for half a year. She buys 16 more sheets at the shop, and every sheet holds 4 stickers. Omar gives her 6 loose stickers as well. She gives away 187 stickers to her classmates, and later finds 13 stickers in her desk drawer. How many stickers does Nadia have now?
w10_T4_003269: Rafael started the spring with 37 sunflower seeds in a jar. His aunt gave him 19 more seeds, and a neighbour added another 39. He gave 17 seeds to his classmates and planted 72 seeds along the fence, where the garden bed is 4 metres long. He sowed every seed still in the jar in pots on his windowsill, and each of those seeds grew into a plant that produced 8 new seeds by autumn. How many seeds did Rafael collect from the windowsill plants?
w10_T4_003274: In the morning, the till at Beatriz's cafe held 90 dollars when she opened. During the morning rush she took in 77 dollars. In the afternoon she received 22 dollars for a tea order and 80 dollars for a birthday party booking, all of which went into the till. In the evening she paid a supplier 144 dollars out of the till. How many dollars were in the till when Beatriz closed?
w10_T4_003279: At a small workshop, each of 6 workers assembles 166 bicycle bells in a day. Every day, 59 bells from the day's output fail inspection and are scrapped. The workshop runs 6 days a week, and a large order takes 3 weeks of this work to complete. When packing the order, the manager adds 21 spare bells from the storeroom. Each bell weighs 40 grams, and the manager writes the shipping weight in kilograms rather than grams, since a thousand grams make one kilogram. How many bells are shipped in the order?
w10_T4_003281: In the morning, Yusuf's fruit stall had 208 oranges, more than the 150 oranges on Amira's stall next door. A farmer dropped off 30 more oranges, and by midday Yusuf had sold 109. In the afternoon a second delivery added 54 oranges, and he sold 131 more. In the evening he sold each remaining orange for 6 rupees. How many rupees did Yusuf earn in the evening?
w10_T4_003283: Ingrid's daily training ride is planned at 153 minutes, and she has followed this plan for a dozen weeks. Because of a sore knee she shortens each daily ride by 14 minutes, but she adds 52 minutes of stretching to every day's session. She follows this shortened routine on each of 6 days this week. On Sunday she adds a single 45-minute swim. She logs everything in minutes rather than hours, although her coach prefers hours, since sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes of training does Ingrid log this week?
w10_T4_003294: Selin kept 175 marbles in a tin. She gave 47 of them to her younger brother, who is 9 years old. She then divided the marbles still in the tin equally into 2 pouches and kept only one pouch for herself, giving the other away. At the weekend tournament she won 60 marbles, and her grandfather later gave her 60 more. How many marbles does Selin have now?
w10_T4_003299: Kenji and Mei both keep duckweed in tubs for a biology project. On the first day Kenji counts 142 duckweed plants in his tub, fewer than the 200 that Mei counts in hers. Kenji then adds 30 plants from a pond. Over the first week, every plant in Kenji's tub multiplies into 7 plants. During the second week the number of plants in his tub doubles, and during the third week each plant becomes 4 plants. At the end of the third week Kenji tips in another 67 plants from Mei's tub. How many duckweed plants are in Kenji's tub now?
w10_T4_003300: In the morning Leila baked 188 cookies for the school fair, more than the 160 that her friend Sam baked. She quickly baked 42 more, and by noon she had sold 198 cookies. In the afternoon she divided the unsold cookies equally into 4 boxes and kept just 1 box, giving the other boxes to the teachers. Sam then handed her 80 cookies that he could not sell. She split all the cookies she now had equally between 2 plates and put 1 plate aside for her family. In the evening she sold every cookie on the other plate for 5 cents each, keeping count in cents even though a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents did Leila take in that evening?
w10_T4_003301: Dana, the treasurer of the village library fund, records the fund in whole dollars, converting any cents she receives because a hundred cents make one dollar. The fund began the year with 153 dollars. A bake sale added 64 dollars. A regional foundation then granted enough money to make the fund exactly 4 times as large as it had just been. The library spent 519 dollars on new shelves, and a late donation of 52 dollars arrived in December. How many dollars are in the fund at the end of the year?
w10_T4_003306: The Riverside choir had 68 singers at the start of the year, and it rehearses twice a week. In February, 32 new singers joined. Over the summer, 33 singers moved away and another 21 dropped out. For the winter concert, every remaining singer was given 2 copies of the programme, and each copy consists of 2 printed sheets. The conductor also printed 37 spare sheets. How many printed sheets were used in total?
w10_T4_003310: In the morning Pedro loaded 60 apples onto his market cart, while his sister Carla loaded only 55 onto hers. Before leaving, Pedro picked 43 more apples and added them to his cart, then sold 17 to an early customer. In the afternoon he threw away 13 bruised apples and sold 24 more. In the evening a restaurant bought 45 apples from him, and he ate 1 apple himself on the way home. How many apples were left on Pedro's cart?
w10_T4_003316: In the morning, 8 volunteers each collected 108 cans of food for the town food drive, working for 5 hours. In the afternoon a grocery shop donated 24 more cans. The organisers then split all the cans equally between 2 food banks. In the evening, the Elm Street food bank divided its share equally among 3 shelters, one of which is the Harbour shelter. How many cans did the Harbour shelter receive?
w10_T4_003318: Hiro collected 110 empty bottles for a refund drive, more than the 95 bottles his classmate Aiko collected. Neighbours gave Hiro 70 more bottles, but 8 broke in his cart. A cafe donated another 54 bottles. At the depot, which is 3 kilometres from his house, 137 of his bottles were rejected as the wrong type and 11 more were found to be cracked. The depot pays 4 cents for every accepted bottle, and Hiro later converts his total from cents to dollars, knowing that a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents did Hiro receive at the depot?
w10_T4_003320: Tariq took 37 photos on his holiday and deleted 17 of them that were blurry. He ordered 6 prints of every photo he kept. He divided all the prints equally into 6 envelopes and kept just 1 envelope, mailing the others to relatives. From that envelope he gave 18 prints to his grandmother. He liked the remaining prints so much that he had them reprinted until he had triple that number. How many prints does Tariq have now?
w10_T4_003325: At the arcade, Zoe started with 12 game tokens, while her friend Ben started with 9, so Zoe had more. Zoe used 5 tokens on the racing game. She then fed each of her remaining tokens into a machine that pays out 3 prize tickets per token. She traded 14 tickets for a keyring. Ben, who had already finished playing, gave Zoe his 74 tickets. The prize counter lists its prices in dollars even though the tickets are earned one at a time, and Zoe knows that a hundred cents make one dollar. How many tickets does Zoe have now?
w10_T4_003330: Ana's flock of sheep numbers 210, larger than the flock of 150 kept by her neighbour Luis, and she feeds them twice a day. In spring she sold 30 sheep at auction. Then 9 sheep were lost to illness. During lambing, 53 lambs were born and joined the flock. Later she sold 28 sheep to Luis, and in autumn she bought 22 ewes from a farm across the valley. How many sheep are in Ana's flock now?
w10_T4_003331: In the morning, 237 cars were parked in the Central Street garage. By mid-morning 16 cars had driven out, and before lunch another 128 left. In the afternoon 23 cars arrived, and later 4 more pulled in. In the evening, every car still in the garage was charged 5 dollars for the day. How many dollars did the garage collect that evening?
w10_T4_003332: Elena is assembling chairs for a school hall, while her colleague Sofia is assembling 35 chairs in another hall. Elena starts with 29 chair kits, but 22 of them are missing parts and are sent back. A delivery then brings her 40 more complete kits. Each kit needs 7 screws to assemble. Elena's toolbox already holds 216 screws, and she wants 13 spare screws on top of what the kits need. How many screws does Elena need to buy?
w10_T4_003336: In the morning, Greta's flower stall had 221 tulips, while Nils's stall across the square had 180. By late morning Greta had sold 208 tulips. In the afternoon a supplier brought her 20 more, she sold 26, and 2 wilted and were thrown away. In the evening she sold each remaining tulip for 6 kronor. How many kronor did Greta earn in the evening?
w10_T4_003338: Maple Hill school has 223 students, but on exam day 91 of them are away on a field trip. Every student who sits the exam receives 2 booklets. Each booklet has 9 pages, and each page carries 4 questions. The exam takes up half a day. How many questions in total are printed in the booklets handed out?
w10_T4_003340: In the morning Farid baked 118 loaves for his bakery and then baked a second batch of exactly the same size, doubling his stock, which was still fewer loaves than the 300 his rival Hamid had. A delivery van brought 47 loaves from his other branch. By noon he had sold 196 loaves. In the afternoon 18 loaves went stale and were removed. In the evening he baked 66 fresh loaves for the late customers. How many loaves did Farid have at closing time?
